title: Panda extension <-> bridge protocol v1 (spec §24, §25, §27, §58, §71)
description: Single source of truth for wire messages, shared types, error codes and the MCP tool registry. C# and TypeScript are generated by schema/codegen.mjs — never hand-write these types. Supported subset: see codegen.mjs.

PROTOCOL_ERROR.description: Relay protocol error: a frame the relay does not accept here (e.g. dialer data before RELAY_STREAM_OPEN).

DIAL_REFUSED.description: Dial token refused; only ever sent for a relayId that is online.

REGISTRATION_INVALID.description: RELAY_REGISTER proof invalid (signature, nonce or host).

NOT_ONLINE.description: relayId not online, or unknown / expired streamId; checked before the token.

REPLACED.description: Control socket replaced by a newer registration of the same relayId.

ACCEPT_TIMEOUT.description: The extension did not accept the stream within 15 s.

SLOT_TAKEN.description: A stream of that kind is already open for that relayId.

QUOTA_EXCEEDED.description: Quota of that relayId used up; reason = retry-after seconds (decimal).

DIALER_LIMITED.description: The dialer's IP is over its refused-dial / registration limit; reason = retry-after seconds. Never a Chrome's quota.

ErrorCode.description: Standard error codes (spec §35 + §66). CANCELLED is internal only (§65.2) and is not listed.

dialog.description: Only on DIALOG_OPEN of a protocol-3 command (plan-phase3 D16).

actionDispatched.description: Protocol-3 commands only: whether the page action was dispatched (plan-phase3 D5, AC4); absent = unknown.

Page.description: A tab as seen by the bridge. Never carries a Chrome tabId (spec §5, §71.6).

url.description: Truncated by the extension to 2048 UTF-16 units (spec §71.1)

title.description: Truncated by the extension to 256 UTF-16 units (spec §71.1)

Hello.description: extension -> bridge, first message of an authenticated connection (§58.2).

ledgerEpoch.description: Protocol ≥ 4 only — the extension sends it only on a v4 link (a v3 bridge refuses unknown fields). Random id of the extension's request ledger (storage.session); it changes when that storage is cleared (extension reload/update, browser restart) or for another copy of the browser. The bridge resends a write only to the epoch its first copy went to (plan-phase4 D1/D2). Not a secret.

bridgeVersion.description: plan-update-daemon D1: the local daemon's release version (a.b.c), only on a local link at protocol >= 14; absent on a relay link or when the build's version is not a.b.c.

uploadDir.description: plan-upload-display D2: the local bridge's upload folder (its final path), only on a READY local link at protocol >= 13; absent = none set.

PairHello.description: extension -> bridge, first message of a pairing socket (§58.1, §71.4).

PairDone.description: Carries pairingSecret on the WebSocket; NATIVE_PAIRED is the only other carrier (INV-a, spec §58.3).

NativeSetupCause.description: Why the extension asks the native host to pair (plan-native ND6a).

NativeErrorReason.description: Popup line for a NATIVE_ERROR (plan-native ND3, ND8).

NativeSetup.description: extension -> native host: pair (or re-pair) this browser and issue an MCP token (§58.3).

NativeStart.description: extension -> native host: start the daemon only; the pair and token stay (§58.3).

NativePaired.description: native host -> extension: one generation of pairing secret + MCP token (§58.3, §71.7).

NativeStarted.description: native host -> extension: the daemon is listening.

NativeError.description: native host -> extension: failure with a standard error (§35) and a popup reason.

CmdSnapshot.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 2: read the page's accessibility snapshot (plan-phase2 D3, D5).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdGetText.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 2: innerText of the page, or of one ref of a kept snapshot (ref requires snapshotId).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdScreenshot.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 2: capture the viewport or the full page; protocol ≥ 8 also one element (snapshotId + ref, not with fullPage — plan-phase8 D5).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

snapshotId.description: With ref: capture that element's border box (both or neither).

ref.description: The element to capture, from snapshotId's snapshot.

SnapshotResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_SNAPSHOT; one line per element or content line, newline-separated.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).
Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

ScreenshotResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_SCREENSHOT; width/height are image px.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

cssWidth.description: The layout viewport's CSS width — a viewport capture at visual scale 1 only (plan-phase8 AC5).

cssHeight.description: The layout viewport's CSS height (as cssWidth).

CommandError.description: Extension → bridge: a CMD_* failed; error.code is a standard code (spec §35/§66).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

DialogType.description: A JavaScript dialog's kind (CDP Page.DialogType; plan-phase3 D16).

DialogInfo.description: The open dialog of a DIALOG_OPEN error (spec §62.1, plan-phase3 D16); the message is a fixed text when the dialog's frame is not allowed (C5).

PointerAction.description: What CMD_POINTER does at the ref's point (plan-phase3 D8).

KeyName.description: page_press_key keys (spec §14, plan-phase3 D11); the MCP name drops "+" and lowercases the first letter (Control+A → controlA).

WaitKind.description: page_wait conditions, exactly one per call (spec §17, §63, plan-phase3 D15). networkIdle (spec §74.6, plan-phase4 D1/D6) goes only to a link at protocol 4: the bridge gates it.

CmdPointer.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 3: click, hover or scroll into view the element of a ref (plan-phase3 D7–D9); protocol ≥ 8 also at a viewport point (x, y) with click options (plan-phase8 D1): exactly one of snapshotId + ref / x + y, options only with click.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

x.description: CSS px from the visual viewport's top-left, as Input.* takes them (the layout viewport's at zoom 1; plan-phase8 AC1, P6).

modifiers.description: CDP modifier bits: Alt 1, Control 2, Meta 4, Shift 8.

CmdFill.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 3: replace a field's value (spec §12, plan-phase3 D10).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdSelectOption.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 3: select an option of a <select> by value or label, exactly one (spec §63, plan-phase3 D12).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdType.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 3: type text into the focused element, or into a ref after focusing it (spec §13, plan-phase3 D11).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdPressKey.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 3: press one key or key combination (spec §14, plan-phase3 D11); protocol ≥ 8 also a chord (plan-phase8 D4): exactly one of key / chord.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdScroll.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 3: scroll by direction + amount, or to x/y (exactly one form; spec §15, plan-phase3 D12). Protocol ≥ 11: the direction form may name where the wheel turns — over a ref (snapshotId + ref) or at a viewport point (atX + atY) — plan-inner-scroll AC1.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

atX.description: With atY and direction: the wheel's point, CSS px from the visual viewport's top-left (page_click's point rule; plan-inner-scroll AC3).

atY.description: With atX: the point's vertical position.

CmdNavigate.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 3: navigate to a URL, reload, back or forward (spec §7, plan-phase3 D13).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

url.description: http or https only, no whitespace / control / separator characters — an explicit class so .NET and JS agree (plan-phase3 D13); the extension also requires an allowed origin.

CmdOpenPage.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 3: open a new tab (spec §6.3, plan-phase3 D14); no pageId yet.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

url.description: http or https only, no whitespace / control / separator characters — an explicit class so .NET and JS agree (plan-phase3 D13); the extension also requires an allowed origin.

groupTitle.description: plan-multi-agent D6 / seam S3 (spec §93): the tab group of a named agent's page_open, "Panda · <token name>"; absent = the default green "Panda AI Browser" group. Sent only on a link READY at >= 17.

CmdTab.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 3: activate or close a page (spec §6.4–6.5, plan-phase3 D14).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdWait.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 3: wait until one condition holds or timeoutMs passes (spec §17, §63, plan-phase3 D15).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdCancel.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 4: the MCP call of this requestId was cancelled — dispatch nothing more for it and never answer it (spec §65.2, plan-phase4 D4).

requestId.description: The requestId of the cancelled command.

CmdHandleDialog.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 3: accept or dismiss the page's JavaScript dialog; bypasses every queue (spec §62.1, plan-phase3 D16).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

ActionResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to every protocol-3 write command — the small result of spec §64.2 (plan-phase3 D2).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

scrollX.description: Window scroll position in CSS px, rounded; negative on right-to-left pages.

scrollY.description: Window scroll position in CSS px, rounded; negative on right-to-left pages.

outOfRange.description: plan-input-hints AC4: page_fill set a value past the input's min / max.

WaitResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_WAIT; matched false = the timeout passed first (plan-phase3 D15).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

ConsoleSource.description: Where a console message came from: a console API call or an uncaught exception.

NetworkEntryKind.description: A request hop, or the marker of a cross-process main-frame navigation (plan-phase5a D3).

BodyUnavailable.description: Why a response body is not given (plan-phase5a AC5).

CmdDrag.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 5: drag the element of ref onto the element of toRef, both from one snapshot (plan-phase5a D7); protocol ≥ 8 either end may be a viewport point (x, y / toX, toY — plan-phase8 D11).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

x.description: Drag source, CSS px of the viewport as for CMD_POINTER x (plan-phase8 AC8).

toX.description: Drop point, CSS px as x.

CmdConsole.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 5: the page's newest console messages (plan-phase5a D6).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdNetworkRecord.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 5: start (on) or stop (off, naming its recordingId) recording the page's network requests (plan-phase5a D3).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

recordingId.description: One recording of one page (plan-phase5a D3).

CmdNetworkList.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 5: the recorded requests, oldest first, after an optional requestRef (plan-phase5a AC4).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdNetworkGet.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 5: one recorded request with its redacted headers, and its response body when asked (plan-phase5a AC5).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

ConsoleMessage.description: One console message (plan-phase5a AC2): text not redacted, ≤ 2000 UTF-16 units.

NetworkRequestSummary.description: One recorded request hop (plan-phase5a AC4); the url is redacted (D5).

NetworkHeader.description: One header; the value is redacted unless allowlisted (plan-phase5a D5).

ConsoleResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_CONSOLE — oldest first among the newest `limit`.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

NetworkRecordResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_NETWORK_RECORD — the page's recording state after it.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

recordingId.description: One recording of one page (plan-phase5a D3).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

recordingId.description: One recording of one page (plan-phase5a D3).

NetworkRequestResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_NETWORK_GET — never a request body (only hasPostData); a response body is not redacted (plan-phase5a AC5).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdEvaluate.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 6: call the agent's function in the page's main world; args are refs of snapshotId, passed as the elements (plan-phase5b S1). The bridge refuses args without snapshotId before sending.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

function.description: JavaScript function source, e.g. "() => document.title"; not blank (whitespace = .NET's and JavaScript's \s together, spelled out).

CmdUpload.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 6: set the files of the <input type=file> of ref; answered by ACTION_RESULT (plan-phase5b S2). Exactly one of files / urls (plan-upload-url D1, not expressible here: the bridge checks, the extension re-checks).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

items.description: A final path in the \\?\ form (plan-phase5b O1), no control characters. This pattern checks only that form: that the path is inside the upload folder is the bridge's check (S3), never implied by a valid message.

urls.description: plan-upload-url D1: files the user's Chrome fetches (http(s), credentials omitted) and sets on the input in this order; only on a link at protocol >= 15.

UploadUrl.description: One file of CMD_UPLOAD urls (plan-upload-url D1): the http(s) URL Chrome fetches; name / mimeType override the derived ones (AC8).

EvaluateResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_EVALUATE. valueJson is the page's JSON text of the result, clipped (truncated) and not guaranteed valid JSON; absent when the result serialises to undefined (undefined, a function, a symbol); exception is the thrown error's text (plan-phase5b S1, O4).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

FormField.description: One field of page_fill_form (plan-phase6 AC2, seam S1): a ref of the command's snapshot and its new value (page_fill's bound).

FormFieldValue.description: One field of FILL_FORM_RESULT (plan-phase6 AC2): the ref and the value read back after the fill; no value for a password field.

CmdResize.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 7: emulate the tab's viewport size (Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride), or with reset clear it; answered by ACTION_RESULT (plan-phase6 AC1, seam S2). Exactly one form (reset true without a size, or reset false with width and height) is the bridge's check; the extension re-checks it.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdFillForm.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 7: fill 1..20 fields (text, or the date / time / color / range inputs page_fill sets — plan-date-inputs) of one snapshot with page_fill's rules, every field checked before the first fill; answered by FILL_FORM_RESULT (plan-phase6 AC2, seam S3). Distinct refs are the bridge's check; the extension re-checks them.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

RangeSide.description: plan-input-hints AC4: which limit a filled value is past — above max (rangeOverflow) or below min (rangeUnderflow).

RangeNote.description: plan-input-hints AC4 (D1): page_fill set a value its input's min / max does not allow (the page's form will refuse it); min / max only when valid for the input's type (D3).

FieldRangeNote.description: plan-input-hints AC5 (D1): a RangeNote for one field of page_fill_form, by its ref.

FillFormResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_FILL_FORM — one entry per field, in input order, never partial (plan-phase6 AC2, seam S3).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

outOfRange.description: plan-input-hints AC5: the fields whose value is past their min / max once the form is filled.

CmdWaitCondition.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 7: call the agent's function in the page's main world every 250 ms until it returns a truthy value or timeoutMs passes (plan-phase6 AC3, seam S4). Runs only while the popup scripts switch is on.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

function.description: JavaScript function source, e.g. "() => document.title"; not blank (whitespace = .NET's and JavaScript's \s together, spelled out).

ConditionResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_WAIT_CONDITION. matched false = the timeout passed after at least one completed call; exception = the last call's thrown text when no call matched and the last one threw; url = the main frame's URL, cut and redacted like WAIT_RESULT's (plan-phase6 AC3, seam S4).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdRequestHuman.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 16: show the user Panda's bar "Agent cần bạn" with the reason and Xong / Từ chối on the page, and wait for the answer at most timeoutMs (spec §92, plan-human-handoff seam S1).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

reason.description: What the agent needs the user to do, as the agent wrote it; not blank. The extension cleans and cuts it to 200 code points before showing it (plan-human-handoff D6); never logged.

HumanResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_REQUEST_HUMAN. done / declined = the user pressed Xong / Từ chối; waiting = timeoutMs passed with no answer, the bar stays (spec §92).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdSiteTools.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 18: list the tools the page's main frame registered through WebMCP, read fresh (spec §95, plan-webmcp seam S1). A read.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

SiteToolsResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_SITE_TOOLS. The first 64 tools of the main frame, cleaned (plan-webmcp D5); truncated = there were more. Every field is the page's text.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

SiteTool.description: One tool a page registered (WebMCP). inputSchemaJson is the page's JSON Schema as JSON text, absent when larger than 16384 UTF-16 units; the booleans are the page's own claims (spec §95).

name.description: The site tool's name as the page registered it (page text, never logged).

CmdCallSiteTool.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 18: invoke the main frame's site tool `name` once with the JSON object inputJson and wait for its answer at most timeoutMs (spec §95, plan-webmcp seam S1). Never re-executed.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

name.description: The site tool's name as the page registered it (page text, never logged).

inputJson.description: The agent's input object as JSON text (the bridge checked it is an object); never logged.

SiteToolResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_CALL_SITE_TOOL — the site tool's own answer. outputJson is the output as JSON text (absent when the tool returned nothing, or tooLarge past 262144); message is the first line of the page's error (spec §95). Page text, never logged.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

SiteToolStatus.description: How a site tool answered (WebMCP toolResponded: Completed / Error / Canceled — spec §95).

CmdLocate.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 19: find the main frame's element whose role and ancestor path equal these EXACTLY and whose name equals this one once both are normalized — whitespace collapsed and trimmed; a name of whitespace only matches nothing (spec §98 — replay only, the narrow exception to §61; plan-record-replay D4, seam S4). A read.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

role.description: A raw Chrome accessibility role (letters only, e.g. button, textbox, RootWebArea).

name.description: The element's accessible name as Chrome computes it, whitespace collapsed and trimmed (page text, never logged).

path.description: The roles of the element's meaningful ancestors, nearest first, up to (not including) RootWebArea (plan-record-replay D3).

LocateResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_LOCATE. matched = how many elements equal the step (2 = two or more, or more than 20 of the step's role + name whose paths are not read — critic T2a r1 O1); only at 1 the element is a ref of a new one-ref snapshot (snapshotId + ref, the locate ring — D4). url = the page's origin + path at the locate.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

RecSave.description: Extension → bridge, protocol ≥ 19, on the LOCAL link only: store this recording on this PC (spec §98, plan-record-replay D5, seam S2). The extension's own request; REC_SAVED answers it. Never through a relay.

RecSaved.description: Bridge → extension: answer to REC_SAVE, naming its recordingId; error = it was not stored (PERMISSION_DENIED on a relay link, QUOTA_EXCEEDED, INTERNAL_ERROR — seam S2).

recordingId.description: A recording's id: a lowercase uuid v4 minted by the service worker at save (plan-record-replay D5).

Recording.description: A recording, v1 (spec §98, plan-record-replay T1): the user's steps, never a typed value. Its start URL is steps[0].url (derived, one source).

recordingId.description: A recording's id: a lowercase uuid v4 minted by the service worker at save (plan-record-replay D5).

name.description: The user's name for it (never logged).

createdAt.description: Unix time in ms when it was saved.

gap.description: Events may be missing: the service worker restarted while recording (plan-record-replay D8).

RecordingStep.description: One recorded step (spec §98). Which fields a kind carries is checked by the recorder and the bridge's store (plan-record-replay T1): click / fill / select / press name an element (role, name, path); fill has slot; select has option; press has key (+ mods); unresolved has why. No field ever holds what the user typed.

url.description: The page's origin + path at the step — never a query, a fragment or credentials (critic T1 #1); the origin only when the path held a typed word.

role.description: A raw Chrome accessibility role (letters only, e.g. button, textbox, RootWebArea).

name.description: The element's accessible name as Chrome computes it, whitespace collapsed and trimmed (page text, never logged).

path.description: The roles of the element's meaningful ancestors, nearest first, up to (not including) RootWebArea (plan-record-replay D3).

slot.description: A fill's input name: the key of recording_replay's inputs (plan-record-replay D7).

option.description: A select's chosen option label (page text).

RecordingKey.description: The keys a press step records (spec §98: never a character key).

RecordingModifier.description: A modifier held during a press step (plan-record-replay D1).

RecordingUnresolvedWhy.description: Why a step names no element: its name held a word the user typed (typedText), the page left before Panda read it (gone), or no ancestor has a role and a name (noTarget).

RelayStreamKind.description: What a relay stream carries (plan-relay S1/S2): a pairing or an authenticated link.

RelayChallenge.description: relay -> extension, first frame on /v1/browser: the nonce RELAY_REGISTER signs (§78.2, plan-relay S1).

RelayRegister.description: extension -> relay within 10 s: ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 over "panda-relay-register-v1" ‖ 0x00 ‖ nonce ‖ host, plus the dial-token hashes (plan-relay S1).

link.description: base64url(SHA-256(link dial token)); absent = no link token.

pair.description: base64url(SHA-256(pair dial token)); absent = no pair token.

RelayDialTokens.description: extension -> relay: replaces the registered dial-token hashes (absent = none).

seq.description: Counter per control socket; RELAY_TOKENS_OK echoes it once the set applies.

link.description: base64url(SHA-256(link dial token)); absent = no link token.

pair.description: base64url(SHA-256(pair dial token)); absent = no pair token.

RelayTokensOk.description: relay -> extension: the RELAY_DIAL_TOKENS with this seq is applied.

seq.description: Counter per control socket; RELAY_TOKENS_OK echoes it once the set applies.

RelayIncoming.description: relay -> extension: a bridge dialled; accept on /v1/stream?accept={streamId} within 15 s.

RelayStreamOpen.description: relay -> dialer: the extension accepted; binary tunnel frames only from now on.

RelayPing.description: Either direction on the control socket; the extension sends one every 20 s (its service-worker keepalive, decisions.md).

RelayHost.description: extension -> relay, URL-only mode (plan-relay-url D4): host this Chrome on the hosted bridge with a connection code minted in this same request. Never logged.

seq.description: The extension's request counter on this control socket (plan-relay-url S1); RELAY_HOST_RESULT echoes it.

code.description: The connection code (§78.11 form, printable ASCII, ≤ 200); the hosted bridge parses and checks it.

tokenSha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the MCP token the extension made; the token itself never leaves the Chrome.

RelayRotate.description: extension -> relay, URL-only mode: replace this Chrome's MCP token on the live hosting (no re-pairing).

seq.description: The extension's request counter on this control socket (plan-relay-url S1); RELAY_HOST_RESULT echoes it.

tokenSha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the MCP token the extension made; the token itself never leaves the Chrome.

RelayUnhost.description: extension -> relay, URL-only mode: revoke this Chrome's MCP token and unpair it from the hosted bridge. Idempotent.

seq.description: The extension's request counter on this control socket (plan-relay-url S1); RELAY_HOST_RESULT echoes it.

RelayHostResult.description: relay -> extension: the outcome of the RELAY_HOST / RELAY_ROTATE / RELAY_UNHOST with this seq. Never echoes the code or the token hash.

seq.description: The extension's request counter on this control socket (plan-relay-url S1); RELAY_HOST_RESULT echoes it.

mcpUrl.description: The public MCP URL (printable ASCII, ≤ 300; ok HOST / ROTATE only); the extension checks its host (plan-relay-url D4).

RelayHostError.description: Why a RELAY_HOST / RELAY_ROTATE / RELAY_UNHOST failed (plan-relay-url S1).

MouseButton.description: The mouse button of a click, protocol ≥ 8 (plan-phase8 D1).

KeyChord.description: A key with modifiers, protocol ≥ 8 (plan-phase8 D1, D4): the bridge sends one only when the pair is not one of the 20 KeyNames.

code.description: A KeyboardEvent.code of the plan-phase8 AC3 set (grouped so both anchors bind the whole alternation).

modifiers.description: CDP modifier bits: Alt 1, Control 2, Meta 4, Shift 8.

DownloadState.description: A download's state (plan-downloads AC1): Chrome's in_progress / complete / interrupted (CDP inProgress / completed / canceled).

DownloadInfo.description: One download a page began while Panda was attached to it (plan-downloads AC1, D1, D6). path = Chrome's full local path once chosen (while in progress the bytes are in a .crdownload beside it); an optional field is omitted when Chrome's value is empty or does not fit.

url.description: Redacted like a network request URL.

path.description: Omitted when empty or longer — never cut.

CmdDownloads.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 9: the page's downloads, newest first (plan-downloads AC1). A read: answered without attaching.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

DownloadsResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_DOWNLOADS — at most 20, newest first (plan-downloads AC1).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

watchId.description: The extension's download watch; a new one after the service worker restarted (plan-downloads AC1).

CmdWaitDownload.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 9: wait until the target download is no longer in progress or timeoutMs passes (plan-downloads AC2, D7). Target: downloadRef; or the first download newer than after; or neither = the first the page began after its latest download-capable command (and after the last one a wait returned). At most one of downloadRef / after is the bridge's check; the extension re-checks it.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

DownloadWaitResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_WAIT_DOWNLOAD. matched = the target is complete or interrupted; at the timeout matched false, with the target's current state when there is one, without download when none began (plan-downloads AC2).

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

watchId.description: The extension's download watch; a new one after the service worker restarted (plan-downloads AC1).

EmulatedGeolocation.description: Integers on the wire (plan-netemu D2a): the bridge converts the tool's decimal degrees and metres.

Emulation.description: The whole wanted emulation of a page (plan-netemu D3: replace, not merge; {} = clear all); in OVERRIDES_RESULT the confirmed fields. acceptLanguage only with userAgent is the bridge's check; the extension re-checks it.

userAgent.description: Printable ASCII (Chrome refuses control characters, plan-netemu P0 j14).

acceptLanguage.description: Language tags only, such as vi-VN,vi: Chrome adds the q-values itself (plan-netemu P4 E2E — a ;q= of the caller's went out twice).

timezone.description: IANA-shaped; the extension checks it with Intl and sends Intl's canonical id (plan-netemu D6).

RuleAction.description: plan-netemu D4: block fails the request (BlockedByClient); headers sets request headers; mock answers it.

RuleHeader.description: A request header (headers rule) or a response header (mock rule); the refused names (plan-netemu D4) are the bridge's check, re-checked by the extension.

value.description: Printable ASCII and tab; no CR / LF.

NetworkRule.description: One rule; the first matching rule acts (plan-netemu D4). Per action (headers: 1..20 headers, nothing else; mock: at most one of body / bodyBase64, decoded ≤ 1 000 000 bytes, ≤ 4 000 000 over the call; block: neither) is the bridge's check, re-checked by the extension.

urlPattern.description: Fetch's wildcard syntax (* any run, ? one character, \ escapes); printable ASCII, no space (plan-netemu D4).

NetworkConditions.description: Network.emulateNetworkConditions (plan-netemu D5); at least one field is the bridge's check.

OverridesViewport.description: The size page_resize put in force (CSS px).

RuleState.description: A rule in force: names and sizes only, never a header value or a body (plan-netemu D13, AC12).

urlPattern.description: Fetch's wildcard syntax (* any run, ? one character, \ escapes); printable ASCII, no space (plan-netemu D4).

hits.description: Requests this rule acted on since this rule list was set (plan-netemu D8).

OverridePart.description: A part whose state Panda could not confirm (plan-netemu D7b); viewport covers the size and deviceScaleFactor.

CmdEmulate.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 10: put exactly this emulation in force on the page (plan-netemu AC5, AC6, D3); answered by OVERRIDES_RESULT.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdNetworkRules.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 10: put exactly these rules and conditions in force on the page (plan-netemu AC1–AC4, AC6); rules [] and no conditions = clear. Answered by OVERRIDES_RESULT.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

CmdOverrides.description: Bridge → extension, protocol ≥ 10: what is in force on the page (plan-netemu AC8). A read: answered without attaching.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).

OverridesResult.description: Extension → bridge: answer to CMD_EMULATE, CMD_NETWORK_RULES and CMD_OVERRIDES — the state Chrome confirmed (plan-netemu D13); a part in unknown shows its last confirmed value.

requestId.description: Bridge-issued command id, echoed by the answer (plan-phase2 S1).
